Building a New Property Process in Real-Time

I recently hosted a live event where I rebuilt our New Property process in real-time. I hosted it as a Zoom Webinar and capped it at 25 people - which maxed out with 39 minutes of announcing the event.

Everyone who missed it live can now watch it for free - right here!

I recreate our New Property process within LeadSimple Process (we currently use Process Street for this). I talk through how I think about what the Stages of the process should be and building each task.
